description: This Java class provides access to MQTT-specific configuration options for the Ditto connectivity services. It manages configuration parameters such as clean session, reconnect behavior, client IDs, and delivery delays, often with default fallback values.

classes.name: MqttSpecificConfig
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating MQTT configuration parameters for the Ditto connectivity services, allowing retrieval of configuration values with defaults and optional fields.

methods.name: fromConnection
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of MqttSpecificConfig from a Connection object by extracting its specific configuration map.

methods.name: cleanSession
methods.description: Indicates whether the MQTT subscriber should use a clean session, defaulting based on reconnectForRedelivery.

methods.name: reconnectForRedelivery
methods.description: Indicates if reconnect for redelivery is activated, defaulting to true.

methods.name: separatePublisherClient
methods.description: Indicates whether a separate MQTT client should be used for publisher actors.

methods.name: getReconnectForDeliveryDelay
methods.description: Retrieves the duration to wait before reconnecting the consumer client for redelivery.

methods.name: getMqttClientId
methods.description: Returns an optional MQTT client ID to be used when connecting to the broker.

methods.name: getMqttPublisherId
methods.description: Returns an optional publisher ID to be used as the client ID of the publisher actor.
